_about: Batting and wicketkeeping drills ADDED to the supplied exercise list (which has none). Standard junior coaching drills; coaches review and edit. Kinds use the same phase rules as every other drill (app/exercise_kinds.py).

skill.name: Shadow batting: grip, stance and trigger
skill.purpose: Grooves a relaxed grip, balanced stance and small trigger movement

skill.name: Balance-and-hold drill off throw-downs
skill.purpose: Holds the finish for two seconds to build head position and balance

skill.name: Front-foot drive drill off throw-downs
skill.purpose: Full front-foot stride, head over the ball, weight transfer forward

skill.name: Back-foot defence and punch drill
skill.purpose: Back and across, playing late under the eyes

skill.name: Side-arm throw-downs against pace
skill.purpose: Repetition against quicker deliveries with soft hands

skill.name: Use-of-feet drill against spin
skill.purpose: Coming down the track to the pitch of the ball, or going right back

skill.name: Soft-hands defence drill against spin
skill.purpose: Plays late with soft hands to avoid bat-pad catches

skill.name: Pull and hook drill with tennis balls
skill.purpose: Safe short-ball play: inside the line, roll the wrists, keep it down

skill.name: Cut-shot drill
skill.purpose: Uses width: back and across, arms extended, hit down

skill.name: Sweep and paddle drill against spin
skill.purpose: Adds sweep options with a stable base and head over the ball

skill.name: Range-hitting drill: hitting zones
skill.purpose: Clears the front leg, full swing, hits to planned boundary zones

skill.name: Rotate-the-strike drill: gaps and singles
skill.purpose: Finds gaps with soft hands and turns dot balls into singles

skill.name: Running between the wickets and calling drill
skill.purpose: Clear calls, backing up, turning quickly for twos

skill.name: Scenario batting: chase a target in set overs
skill.purpose: Pressure practice: plan the innings, manage risk

skill.name: Batting game-plan drill against a set field
skill.purpose: Plans scoring options for a given field and bowler

skill.name: Batting video review
skill.purpose: Compares set-up, trigger and strokes with the coach's model

skill.name: Keeper stance and ready-position drill
skill.purpose: Low, balanced stance with weight on the balls of the feet

skill.name: Clean-takes drill: gloves together, soft hands
skill.purpose: Repeats clean takes with fingers down and gloves giving with the ball

skill.name: Standing-up drill to spin with stumping
skill.purpose: Stays down, takes cleanly and breaks the stumps in one movement

skill.name: Standing-back footwork drill to pace
skill.purpose: Moves early with side steps and takes on the inside hip

skill.name: Lateral diving-take drill on a soft surface
skill.purpose: Explosive push off and safe landing for wide takes

skill.name: Leg-side take drill
skill.purpose: Moves early down the leg side and keeps the head still

skill.name: Reaction-ball takes
skill.purpose: Unpredictable bounce trains fast hands and focus

skill.name: Run-out take and break-the-stumps drill
skill.purpose: Gets to the stumps fast and takes throws in front of them

skill.name: Keeper communication and field-leadership drill
skill.purpose: Calls for catches, sets energy and talks to bowler and fielders

skill.name: Keeping video review
skill.purpose: Checks stance, head position and glove work against the coach's model
